description_en: Adds multiple hosts to a specified asset group in a batch
description_zh: 批量将主机加入指定资产组
kebab_example: aliyun yundun-bastionhost add-hosts-to-group --instance-id bastionhost-cn-st220aw0000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --host-group-id 1 --host-ids 1_,_2_,_3 --region cn-hangzhou
name: AddHostsToGroup

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID of the bastion host where the asset group to which you want to add hosts resides.
You can invoke the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html operation to query this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
要加入主机的资产组所在堡垒机的实例ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html接口获取该参数
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the bastion host instance where the asset group to which you want to add hosts resides.
For the mapping between region IDs and region names, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.help_zh:
要加入主机的资产组所在堡垒机的区域ID。
区域ID和区域名称的对应关系，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the asset group to which you want to add hosts.
You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/201307.html operation to query this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
要加入主机的资产组ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/201307.html接口获取该参数
parameters.name: host_group_id

parameters.help_en:
The IDs of the hosts that you want to add to the asset group. This parameter is a JSON-formatted string. A maximum of 100 host IDs are supported.
You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/200665.html operation to query host IDs
parameters.help_zh:
要加入资产组的主机ID。该参数为JSON格式的字符串，最多支持添加100个主机ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/200665.html接口获取主机ID
parameters.name: host_ids
